GLS.feature.pf2e-saves.title: Save Resolution
GLS.feature.pf2e-saves.hint: Resolve a save spell in one panel: everyone in the area (or targeted) rolls, the damage is rolled once and applied to each creature through its resistances at its degree's multiplier, the spell's conditions land by degree, and every Apply can be reverted.
GLSV.settings.autoOpen.name: Open the panel automatically
GLSV.settings.autoOpen.hint: When a session starts that you run (as the GM, or as the caster's player), open its panel at once.
GLSV.settings.cardButton.name: "Resolve saves" on spell cards
GLSV.settings.cardButton.hint: Add a Resolve saves button beside the save button on a spell's chat card, for the GM and the caster's player.
GLSV.panel.title: Save Resolution
GLSV.empty: Nobody is resolving this save yet. Target creatures and press Add targeted.
GLSV.blocked.title: Blocked
GLSV.blocked.hint: Inside the area, but cut off from its origin (no line of effect).
GLSV.config.title: Effects by degree
GLSV.config.hint: Read from the spell's own text. Your changes are remembered on the spell for its next cast.
GLSV.warn.noSave: That spell has no saving throw to resolve.
GLSV.warn.noSpell: The spell this session was opened for no longer exists.
GLSV.warn.noGM: Save Resolution needs a GM connected.
GLSV.warn.noTargets: Target the creatures to add first.
GLSV.warn.expired: Too late to revert: the encounter ended, or it has been more than ten minutes.
